traversal: two independent Chromium launches; union of locale/mode/theme/viewport/media/state matrix

deletionPolicy.requirement: A rule must remain unused across both independent full state-matrix passes; removal still requires a small reviewed change.
deletionPolicy.visualGate: Linux, Windows, and macOS hosted-runner visual baselines must pass after any deletion.

caveats: The matrix covers hover/focus, print, reduced-motion, forced-colors, compact viewports, delayed mounts, and representative overlays.
Chromium coverage cannot establish Firefox/WebKit-only selector reachability; vendor-specific rules require source review.
